summary.text: One of the forty-four suitors from Zacynthus in Apollodorus' island catalogue — distinct from `clytius-same` in Epitome 7.27 and from Clytius among the Same wooers in Epitome 7.28.

story.text: Apollodorus names Clytius among the wooers assigned to Zacynthus, listed after Evenorides and before Agenor in Epitome 7.29.
